edits.headline: Israeli officials say diverted flydubai flight may be terror attack
edits.subheadline: The co-pilot of flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv allegedly stabbed the captain before the plane landed in Saudi Arabia, Reuters reported.
editorialBody: Israeli officials said an incident on a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on 30 September may have been an attempted "terror attack", Reuters reported.
The co-pilot of flight FZ1073 allegedly stabbed the captain. A second pair of flydubai pilots on board landed the plane in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, Reuters reported.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said 174 people were on board, most of them Israeli nationals. He called it "a serious security incident".
A Tokyo court ruled that an AI tool that copied the voice of actor Kenjiro Tsuda violated his rights, The Guardian reported. The case was brought against TikTok, the Associated Press reported.
Hackers behind the Bitget breach moved about $4m into Zcash's private pool, making the funds harder to trace, CoinDesk reported.
Citi told investors to sell Moderna shares after gains of more than 600%, MarketWatch reported.
Apple's HomePad smart home hub will reportedly launch on 13 October, The Verge reported.
